title: 撤销重做模式
html:
撤销重做模式

核心概念

撤销重做（Undo/Redo）模式允许用户回退到之前的状态或重新应用已撤销的操作，是提升用户体验的重要功能。

撤销重做的基本要素

要素 说明
历史记录 存储过去的状态
当前索引 指向当前状态在历史中的位置
撤销栈 可以撤销的操作
重做栈 可以重做的操作
历史限制 防止内存无限增长

基础实现

简单的撤销重做

interface UndoRedoState<T> {
  past: T[];
  present: T;
  future: T[];
}

function createUndoRedo<T>(initialState: T): UndoRedoState<T> {
  return {
    past: [],
    present: initialState,
    future: [],
  };
}

function undo<T>(state: UndoRedoState<T>): UndoRedoState<T> {
  if (state.past.length === 0) return state;

  const previous = state.past[state.past.length - 1];
  const newPast = state.past.slice(0, -1);
  const newFuture = [state.present, ...state.future];

  return {
    past: newPast,
    present: previous,
    future: newFuture,
  };
}

function redo<T>(state: UndoRedoState<T>): UndoRedoState<T> {
  if (state.future.length === 0) return state;

  const next = state.future[0];
  const newFuture = state.future.slice(1);
  const newPast = [...state.past, state.present];

  return {
    past: newPast,
    present: next,
    future: newFuture,
  };
}

function pushState<T>(state: UndoRedoState<T>, newPresent: T, limit: number = 50): UndoRedoState<T> {
  const newPast = [...state.past, state.present];
  const trimmedPast = newPast.slice(-limit);

  return {
    past: trimmedPast,
    present: newPresent,
    future: [],
  };
}

let history = createUndoRedo({ count: 0 });

history = pushState(history, { count: 1 });
history = pushState(history, { count: 2 });
history = pushState(history, { count: 3 });

console.log('Current:', history.present); // { count: 3 }

history = undo(history);
console.log('After undo:', history.present); // { count: 2 }

history = undo(history);
console.log('After undo 2:', history.present); // { count: 1 }

history = redo(history);
console.log('After redo:', history.present); // { count: 2 }

在 React 中使用

useUndo Hook

import { useState, useCallback } from 'react'

function useUndo<T>(initialState: T, limit: number = 50) {
  const [history, setHistory] = useState<UndoRedoState<T>>({
    past: [],
    present: initialState,
    future: []
  })

  const canUndo = history.past.length > 0
  const canRedo = history.future.length > 0

  const set = useCallback(
    (newPresent: T) => {
      setHistory((prev) => pushState(prev, newPresent, limit))
    },
    [limit]
  )

  const undo = useCallback(() => {
    setHistory((prev) => undo(prev))
  }, [])

  const redo = useCallback(() => {
    setHistory((prev) => redo(prev))
  }, [])

  const reset = useCallback(() => {
    setHistory(createUndoRedo(initialState))
  }, [initialState])

  return {
    state: history.present,
    set,
    undo,
    redo,
    reset,
    canUndo,
    canRedo
  }
}

function Counter() {
  const { state, set, undo, redo, canUndo, canRedo } = useUndo({ count: 0 })

  return (
    <div>
      <p>Count: {state.count}</p>
      <button onClick={() => set({ count: state.count + 1 })}>+</button>
      <button onClick={() => set({ count: state.count - 1 })}>-</button>
      <button onClick={undo} disabled={!canUndo}>
        Undo
      </button>
      <button onClick={redo} disabled={!canRedo}>
        Redo
      </button>
    </div>
  )
}

命令模式

可撤销的命令

interface Command {
  execute(): void
  undo(): void
}

class AddTodoCommand implements Command {
  private todo: Todo
  private todos: Todo[]

  constructor(todos: Todo[], todo: Todo) {
    this.todos = todos
    this.todo = todo
  }

  execute() {
    this.todos.push(this.todo)
  }

  undo() {
    const index = this.todos.findIndex((t) => t.id === this.todo.id)
    if (index > -1) {
      this.todos.splice(index, 1)
    }
  }
}

class ToggleTodoCommand implements Command {
  private todoId: string
  private todos: Todo[]
  private previousState: boolean | null = null

  constructor(todos: Todo[], todoId: string) {
    this.todos = todos
    this.todoId = todoId
  }

  execute() {
    const todo = this.todos.find((t) => t.id === this.todoId)
    if (todo) {
      this.previousState = todo.completed
      todo.completed = !todo.completed
    }
  }

  undo() {
    if (this.previousState !== null) {
      const todo = this.todos.find((t) => t.id === this.todoId)
      if (todo) {
        todo.completed = this.previousState
      }
    }
  }
}

class CommandManager {
  private history: Command[] = []
  private currentIndex = -1

  execute(command: Command) {
    command.execute()
    this.history = this.history.slice(0, this.currentIndex + 1)
    this.history.push(command)
    this.currentIndex++
  }

  undo() {
    if (this.currentIndex >= 0) {
      this.history[this.currentIndex].undo()
      this.currentIndex--
    }
  }

  redo() {
    if (this.currentIndex < this.history.length - 1) {
      this.currentIndex++
      this.history[this.currentIndex].execute()
    }
  }

  canUndo() {
    return this.currentIndex >= 0
  }

  canRedo() {
    return this.currentIndex < this.history.length - 1
  }
}

function TodoApp() {
  const [todos] = useState<Todo[]>([])
  const commandManager = useRef(new CommandManager()).current

  const addTodo = (text: string) => {
    const todo: Todo = {
      id: Date.now().toString(),
      text,
      completed: false
    }
    commandManager.execute(new AddTodoCommand(todos, todo))
  }

  const toggleTodo = (id: string) => {
    commandManager.execute(new ToggleTodoCommand(todos, id))
  }

  return (
    <div>
      <TodoList todos={todos} onToggle={toggleTodo} />
      <button
        onClick={() => commandManager.undo()}
        disabled={!commandManager.canUndo()}
      >
        Undo
      </button>
      <button
        onClick={() => commandManager.redo()}
        disabled={!commandManager.canRedo()}
      >
        Redo
      </button>
    </div>
  )
}

常见误区

❌ 误区 1：不限制历史记录长度

历史记录会占用内存，设置合理的限制。

❌ 误区 2：每次状态变化都保存

只在重要操作时保存，不是每个字符输入。

❌ 误区 3：不考虑异步操作

异步操作的撤销更复杂，需要仔细处理。

小结

mindmap
  root((撤销重做))
    实现方式
      状态历史栈
      Command Pattern
      Diff/Patch
    数据结构
      past 数组
      present 当前
      future 数组
    优化
      历史上限
      合并连续操作
      选择性记录
    库支持
      redux-undo
      Zustand temporal
      自定义 Hook
  • 状态历史栈是最直观的实现方式
  • Command Pattern 适合需要精确控制的场景
  • 注意设置历史上限和合并连续操作以节省内存
